local:app-host-identity.source: One reverse-DNS app namespace marker per product-owned state root; no credentials
local:app-host-identity.expiry: Removed with the explicit product data deletion flow after its helper has stopped

local:messaging-group-history-exclusions.source: Enrollment-scoped IDs of baseline, historical, or future-dated group messages; no message bodies
local:messaging-group-history-exclusions.expiry: Retained with the enrollment; never evicted independently or copied to another enrollment

local:contract-repair-inbox.source: Validated invocation failures and explicit collection-plan demand; advisory only
local:contract-repair-inbox.expiry: Hidden after 30 days; expired entries are compacted on the next admitted write

local:keychain-notice-record.source: Browsers whose last keychain read returned without a macOS dialog; only hides a repeated notice
local:keychain-notice-record.expiry: Rebuildable; deleting it only brings the keychain notice back

provider:microsoft-graph-reads.status: capture-required; public execution rejects before credentials or network

local:cli-update-policy.source: Explicit update policy and verified installed release receipts; no account or captured content

local:cli-update-archives.source: Verified immutable release archives retained for global package-manager replay
local:cli-update-archives.expiry: Retain manager-referenced archives; cleanup requires proving no installation or running manager references them

local:app-host-x-action-tickets.source: Exact plan digest and account incarnation binding for durable write reconciliation; no credentials or content
local:app-host-x-action-tickets.expiry: Retained with the corresponding durable plan and run evidence; at capacity new unique actions fail closed without eviction. Never creates dispatch authority

local:app-host-x-workspace.source: Account/revision-bound admitted provider output and user-selected local attachment bytes
local:app-host-x-workspace.expiry: Expired during subsequent commands; unused plans cancelled and staged files removed on graceful host close. Runtime encrypted plans and durable receipts retain their existing lifecycle.

local:cancelled-invocation-plans.source: Atomic proof that an exact encrypted invocation plan was cancelled under its single-confirmer claim before any execution journal or receipt existed; digest only
local:cancelled-invocation-plans.expiry: Never expired or replaced by a new plan. Full history refuses new proof without erasing existing recovery evidence; removed only with the stopped product-owned state directory.
